risks.title: Dependency on the performance of 11 Powerbrands
risks.score_rationale: Central risk mentioned from the introduction and throughout the document (pages 1-7). Intensive language: "strategic core", "foundation of growth". Trend stable but critical: the entire strategy rests on these 11 brands. High category weight: portfolio concentration creates competitive vulnerability.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance risks for health and hygiene products
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in the portfolio (OTC, hygiene products, contraception) but not detailed in Item 1A. Moderate language: mention of "science-based solutions" and "product safety" (page 2). Trend stable. High category weight: highly regulated sector (FDA, EMA, national agencies) with approval, reformulation, and withdrawal risks.

risks.title: Supply chain and manufacturing resilience
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned pages 5-6: "investments in manufacturing footprint and supply chain". Moderate but strategic language: Taicang expansion (China), new Shanghai R&D center. Trend up: investments underway. Medium category weight: geographic dependency (China, Italy, USA) and disruption risks.

risks.title: Product innovation and insufficient R&D
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned pages 5-6: "science-led innovation", new Shanghai R&D center, use of generative AI. Moderate language: "digital improvements and GenAI expanding R&D capabilities". Trend stable. Medium category weight: innovation critical for premiumization and category growth.

risks.title: Reputation and ethical-social compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned pages 8-9: "Doing the right thing. Always", inclusion, fairness, safety. Moderate but values-centered language. Trend stable: evolving culture. Medium category weight: health and hygiene sector sensitive to product scandals, labor practices, environment.

risks.title: Dependency on emerging markets and geopolitical volatility
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned page 5: "Emerging Markets, our largest zone by net revenue, with double-digit growth". Moderate language. Trend stable but exposed. Medium category weight: increasing growth concentration in China, India, unstable markets.

risks.title: Integration and execution of organizational transformation
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned pages 4-7: "big changes", reduction in management layers, restructuring, Essential Home divestment. Intensive language: "simultaneous transformation and business performance". Trend up: changes underway. Medium category weight: execution risk and talent retention.

risks.title: Intellectual property and brand protection
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly detailed in Item 1A but implicit: leading brand portfolio (Strepsils, Lysol, Dettol, Durex, Veet). Moderate language: "trusted Powerbrands". Trend stable. Low-medium category weight: counterfeiting risk, patent expiration, IP litigation.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the documents provided. The company does not position AI as a major strategic lever.
